name: io.github.trongio/storewire-lite
title: Storewire Lite demo store
description: Demo Laravel store on Storewire Lite: search an outdoor gear catalog and read product details.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Trailhead Supply catalogue the way its search page does: by words or a model number, within a category or brand, by price in USD, in stock only, and by spec filters. Each product comes with its page URL, photo, price, stock line, key specs and category. The answer also gives the total, the same results' URL on the store's website, suggested_filters (categories and spec values with how many products each would leave) and, when nothing matches, did_you_mean with categories and products the store offers instead.

query.description: Words or a model number. Required unless category or brand is given.

category.description: A category slug from list_categories or suggested_filters.

filters.description: Spec filters from suggested_filters: code => list of values, e.g. {"color": ["black"]}; a numeric spec also takes "min~max". At most 6 codes of 8 values each.

sort.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc or newest.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product as its page on the Trailhead Supply website shows it: name, brand, model, page URL, photos, price, stock line, key specs, the full spec table by group, warranty, a plain-text description, documents with download links, and its category trail. similar lists alternatives; goes_with lists what it needs or works with, each with its relation.

product.description: The product: its public_id from an earlier answer, its page URL or slug on the store's website, or the manufacturer model number.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 products side by side, as the store's compare page does: each product's card, then the spec rows by group with one value per product in the order given, whether each row differs and which value is better where a spec can be ranked. differences says whether any row differs. A product that cannot be compared (another category, past the limit, not found) is listed under rejected with the reason. url opens the same comparison on the store's website when it has a compare page.

products.description: 2 to 4 products of one category: public_id, page URL or model number.

items.description: The product: its public_id from an earlier answer, its page URL or slug on the store's website, or the manufacturer model number.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Whether two Trailhead Supply products work together (product + with), or which products fill a role for one product (product + role: accessory, requires, works_with; up to 8 products on sale, with price and stock). The verdict is listed (the catalogue links the two products), fits_rule (no link, but a catalogue rule matches them; reason says which) or unknown (the catalogue holds no data on the pair; unknown does not mean incompatible).

product.description: The product: its public_id from an earlier answer, its page URL or slug on the store's website, or the manufacturer model number.

with.description: The second product, named the same ways as product. Give this or role.

role.description: Instead of with: the relation to list products for, e.g. accessory for what fits it, requires for what it needs.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The Trailhead Supply catalogue menu: product categories as a tree, each with its name, slug, page URL and number of products on sale. From the top level, or below the category whose slug is given as parent; depth sets how many levels come back (1 to 3, default 2). A slug can narrow a product search.

parent.description: Slug of the category to list below (from an earlier answer); omit for the top level.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: find_documents
tools.description: The downloads Trailhead Supply offers for a product model or a brand (manual, care_guide, size_chart, warranty), grouped by model, each file with its type, title, language, version, size and download link (open_url when a browser can show it inline). Narrow by query (a model number, a product's public_id or URL, or words of a title), by brand and by file type. A file hosted by its manufacturer is marked external.

query.description: A model number, a product's public_id or page URL, or words of a document title.

limit.description: Most files in the answer (default and maximum 20).

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: The public facts of Trailhead Supply as its website shows them: company name, address, opening hours, email and phones; every branch with its address, phone, hours, map link and whether orders can be collected there; messenger contact links; accepted payment methods and whether prices include VAT; the store warranty; the return terms; links to the legal pages; and the frequently asked questions with their answers.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: get_delivery_options
tools.description: Delivery to a city as the Trailhead Supply checkout offers it right now: the delivery zone the city belongs to (matched_city=false means the catch-all rate applies), each courier option with its fee in USD and delivery time, the order total above which delivery is free, and whether same-day delivery is available today, with the reason when it is not. With a product (and quantity) same-day can account for that product's stock; with a basket subtotal each fee is the one that basket would pay.

city.description: The delivery city as the shopper writes it.

product.description: The product: its public_id from an earlier answer, its page URL or slug on the store's website, or the manufacturer model number.

subtotal.description: Basket subtotal in USD: each fee is then what that basket pays.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: cart_add_item
tools.description: Adds units of one product to an anonymous Trailhead Supply cart and returns the whole cart. Without cart_token a new cart is opened and its cart_token returned. Each call adds its units again, so repeating a call raises the quantity. Only products sold online can be added, at the price a visitor pays. The answer's cart_url opens the store's website with the products in the shopper's own cart; nothing is ordered or paid here.

cart_token.description: The cart to add to, from an earlier cart answer; omit it to open a new cart.

product.description: The product: its public_id from an earlier answer, its page URL or slug on the store's website, or the manufacturer model number.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: cart_update_item
tools.description: Sets how many units of a product an anonymous Trailhead Supply cart holds and returns the whole cart; qty 0 removes the product. The product must already be in the cart. A raised quantity is checked against stock as on the website.

cart_token.description: The cart_token an earlier cart answer returned.

product.description: The product: its public_id from an earlier answer, its page URL or slug on the store's website, or the manufacturer model number.

qty.description: The units the cart should hold; 0 removes the product.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: cart_remove_item
tools.description: Removes a product from an anonymous Trailhead Supply cart and returns the whole cart. Removing a product the cart does not hold leaves the cart as it is.

cart_token.description: The cart_token an earlier cart answer returned.

product.description: The product: its public_id from an earlier answer, its page URL or slug on the store's website, or the manufacturer model number.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: cart_view
tools.description: An anonymous Trailhead Supply cart as it stands: each product with its units and line total, the subtotal, how delivery is charged, when the cart expires, and cart_url, which opens the store's website with the products in the shopper's own cart.

cart_token.description: The cart_token an earlier cart answer returned.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

tools.name: show_products
tools.description: Chosen Trailhead Supply products named by public_id, drawn as cards, or as a recommendation: groups by placement with the product, swaps, accessories and a live total. Names, prices and stock are the store's.

public_ids.description: public_id of each product to show as a card.

groups.description: A recommendation: one group per placement. Give either this or public_ids.

placement.description: Where this product goes, in the shopper's words, e.g. "living room".

alternates.description: public_id of products that can replace it.

cart_token.description: An open cart's cart_token. The answer returns it while that cart is live.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.
